# Screenshots

Every `@Preview` in this package is a **README screenshot**: CI renders it into `docs/screenshots/` and commits the
images to the PR branch. Never take or edit them by hand, and don't edit this file either, because CI writes it.

- A file per page that has screenshots; a private `@Preview` per screenshot, with its own mock data. Nothing is shared.
- `order.txt` lists the screenshots in the order the README shows them, one name per line, no comments.

The rules, and how it all works, are in
[`docs/screenshots.md`](https://github.com/LukeNeedham/ci-workflows/blob/main/docs/screenshots.md) of
LukeNeedham/ci-workflows.
